<!--
Requests are prioritised by how many real businesses have the problem, so describe the problem first.
"Add X" with no problem statement will be closed and asked to be rewritten.
-->

### The problem

<!-- What are you trying to do, and what stops you today? Be concrete:
"Every month I re-type 40 purchase bills into Tally because..." beats "Add Tally export". -->

### Who has this problem?

<!-- Your kind of business (trader, manufacturer, service provider...), rough invoices per month,
and whether it is a legal/GST requirement or a convenience. Link the rule or notification if it is a requirement. -->

### How do you handle it today?

<!-- Workaround, other software, spreadsheet, manual work. -->

### Proposed solution (optional)

<!-- What would "done" look like? Screens, fields, reports. -->

### Alternatives considered (optional)
